name: Revenue without join fanout / Chiffre d’affaires sans multiplication des jointures / Ingresos sin multiplicación por joins

intent.fr: Chiffre d’affaires par client, y compris les clients sans commande. Une commande compte une seule fois, quel que soit son nombre de lignes.
intent.en: Revenue per customer, including customers without orders. Count each order once regardless of its line count.
intent.es: Ingresos por cliente, incluidos clientes sin pedidos. Contar cada pedido una vez, independientemente de sus líneas.

reference_sql: SELECT c.id, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(o.total_cents) FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id=c.id),0) AS revenue FROM customers c ORDER BY c.id
candidate_sql: SELECT c.id, SUM(o.total_cents) AS revenue FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.id JOIN lines l ON l.order_id=o.id GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY c.id
